name: Direct transaction with sanctioned party
description: Customer, supplier, agent, owner, or counterparty matches an EU / UK / OFAC list and a transaction proceeds.

name: Sanctioned party using nominee / front
description: True UBO is sanctioned but transacts through a nominee, shell company or front entity that screens clean.

name: Trade with sanctioned-jurisdiction counterparty
description: Counterparty in a sectorally-sanctioned country (Russia, Iran, North Korea, etc.) facilitates restricted goods or services.

name: Sanctions circumvention via third-country re-routing
description: Goods or funds re-routed through a third country to circumvent sanctions; receiving party ultimately resells to sanctioned end-user.

name: Activity outside scope of OFAC / OFSI licence
description: Entity holds a specific licence and transacts outside its scope (volume, counterparty, end-use).
